{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The United States must continue to engage China, a nation with 1.3 billion people, a nuclear arsenal, and a role in the 21st Century that is destined to be one of the basic facts of international life.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The United States must search out ways to cooperate with China across a broad range of issues, such as the environment and trade.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The United States will insist on adherence to international standards on human rights, freedom, the persecution of religions, the suppression of Tibet, and bellicose threats directed at Taiwan.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"China cannot be ignored, and issues related to human rights, freedom, the persecution of religions, the suppression of Tibet, and bellicose threats directed at Taiwan cannot and must not be marginalized.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"A deterioration of the U.S.-China relationship would harm, not help, American national security interests and the promotion of U.S. values.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"A Gore Administration will fulfill its responsibilities under the Taiwan Relations Act.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"A Gore Administration will remain committed to a \"One China\" policy.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The United States supports a resolution of cross-Straits issues that is both peaceful and consistent with the wishes of the people of Taiwan.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
